data.heading: 1-mashq — javoblar kaliti
steps: The house wasn't ______ / wasn't ______ by the owners during the winter.

data.problem: Ma'no o'zgarmasligi uchun passiv bilan to'ldiring. by ni faqat zarur bo'lgandagina ishlatang.
steps: They subtitle a lot of foreign films. → A lot of foreign films ______.
Garcia Marquez wrote Love in the Time of Cholera in 1985. → Love in the Time of Cholera ______ in 1985.
Someone is repairing my laptop at the moment. → My laptop ______ at the moment.

narr: Bu mashqda biz ma'no o'zgarmasligi uchun gaplarni passiv shaklga o'tkazamiz.

data.heading: 2-mashq — ma'no o'zgarmasligi uchun passiv bilan to'ldiring (cont.)

data.problem: Har bir rasmga to'g'ri tavsibni moslang:
steps: A hole is made using a drill.

steps: Hot liquid material is poured into a container and cooled to make the correct shape.
